$beschreibung: Liste der CASI-Vorlagen. Neue Vorlage: Datei in vorlagen/ legen und hier eintragen.

vorlagen.wofuer: Every CASI / ICCA slide deck. Open the .potx (creates a new deck), pick layouts: Titel, Abschnitt, Inhalt, Nur Titel, Zwei Spalten, Text mit Box, Zwei Boxen, Abbildung, Schluss, Leer. Fonts embedded.
Same as CASI-Folien.potx for tools that cannot open .potx (python-pptx, Keynote, Google Slides): copy it, delete the sample slide, add slides from its layouts.

Shows every slide layout filled with text from CASI Whitepaper No. 1 plus current website graphics (ICCA, CO2 Balance Sheet, Strong Incentives, Lower Cost) – reference for how a finished CASI deck looks.

Font package for installing the CASI typefaces on a computer: TTF for Office (Installieren/), WOFF2 for web (Web/). Offer it whenever fonts are missing. PP Mori is licensed to CASI – for CASI staff only, do not pass on to third parties.

Every CASI whitepaper or paper. Double-click opens a new document: cover with input fields (series · number, title, abstract, authors, publisher · date), automatic contents, sample page with every style (CASI Kicker, CASI Ueberschrift 1/2, CASI Fliesstext, CASI Liste, figure field, CASI Bildunterschrift), references and imprint. Header fills itself from the cover. Fonts embedded. Export as PDF for print.
